[Date: 2026-10-17]
[To: Dr. P. Nardelli, Metro Endocrine, Fax: 555-0150]

Dear Dr. Nardelli,

I am writing to refer my patient, Vincent Green, a 40-year-old male, for endocrinology consultation regarding hormone-regimen optimization. Vincent has a history of gender-affirming surgery in 2021 and is currently on long-term hormone therapy. His current medications include lisinopril, amlodipine, and estradiol. He has documented allergies to codeine and latex.

Recent lab results from May 15, 2026, indicate an estradiol level of 142, with total testosterone suppressed. The lipid panel was borderline, and a baseline bone density test has been ordered. His blood pressure is currently managed with lisinopril and amlodipine.

I have confirmed that his insurance plan, Unity HMO, covers this referral, and the necessary PCP referral is on file.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. Please feel free to contact me if you need further information.

Sincerely,
Dr. Almeida
[Primary Care Physician]
